verdict.rationale: Evidence only indirectly confirms CSV-based bulk workflows exist (a community comment notes users falling back to 'CSV parsing with limited information' when API access is restricted) and general Admin/GraphQL API docs for building integrations, but there is no first-party documentation in the pack describing Shopify's native bulk product CSV import/export tool or bulk editor UI. Missing for 10: official docs on the CSV import/export feature, the bulk editor, and GraphQL bulk mutation/bulkOperation API for catalog-wide edits.
